reason_not_run: exceeds the remaining approved synthetic budget; exact resource request in STATUS.md
description: Calibration and power of the within-example label-permutation test at a realistic design. Fixed before any P5-E8 result was seen. The v1 gate (EH1 in p5_first_run.json) and its FAIL verdict are preserved; this config defines a new, separate gate.
seed_scheme: seeds.seed_v2 over {experiment, joint, condition, example, replicate, branch}; fresh conditioning rows per replicate; no common random numbers across cells or branches

design.statistic: T = mean_i ED_V(direct_i, sequential_i) on z / 0.5 (target); mean over 8 fixed directions of projected ED_V on (y/2, z/0.5) (joint); upper tail
design.randomisation: within-example relabelling of individual samples (vectors as units); Monte Carlo p = (1 + #{T_b >= T_obs - tol}) / (B + 1)

primary_endpoint.quantity: rejection rate at nominal alpha = 0.05 over R = 200 independent replicates

gate.null_cells: EXCESS if the one-sided 95% CP lower bound > 0.05; the engineering tolerance additionally requires the one-sided 95% CP upper bound <= 0.10. Passing the tolerance does NOT establish size 0.05; the size claim rests on the permutation argument under the stated exchangeability assumption.
gate.alternative_cells: POWERED if the one-sided 95% CP lower bound > 0.05; the gate requires all four alternative cells POWERED so that an always-accept detector cannot pass
gate.negative_controls: always-accept and always-reject detectors are evaluated with the same rules and must fail
gate.gate_pass: primary and all other null cells within tolerance and not EXCESS, AND all alternative cells POWERED

multiplicity: one primary endpoint; the other cells are secondary engineering diagnostics reported individually without adjustment; the gate is a conjunction and makes no family-wise error claim
independence: replicates independent (fresh rows and seeds); within a replicate, examples independent; permutations and samples are not units; target and joint cells use separate datasets
stop_rule: if the gate fails, report FAIL; do not change estimator, seeds, B, N, M or thresholds and re-run; diagnose only with checks declared here (component-A style enumeration on sub-designs)

resource_estimate.source: P5-E8-EXACT component D timing (results/raw/p5_e8_exact_v1/summary.json), linear extrapolation in M; excludes sampling and sorting overhead
resource_estimate.request: about 40 CPU-minutes (1.5x safety factor) of pure-Python CPU, 2 processes (about 20 min wall); or numpy installation approval (not requested here)
